content: FIXED in 7aa7ae5 (single file, thermite-spec/src/validator.rs, fn check_match_exhaustiveness). The matched_enum-None branch now rejects a match whose every arm is guarded (and which has >=1 arm) with SpecError::NonExhaustiveMatch — a guarded catch-all _ if cond => 0 over an enum names no variant (so the enum is unidentifiable) yet completes nothing (the guard may fail), per 11-ergonomics REQ-3/AC-3b. Approach: all-arms-guarded fallback (the scrutinee-type route is unavailable — the validator AST is untyped, OQ-3). DISTINCTION verified: unguarded _ catch-all stays ACCEPTED (not all-guarded -> exhaustive, no over-reject); guarded-only catch-all -> NonExhaustive; mixed guarded+unguarded and slice/Option/integer matches UNCHANGED (still inferred from variant-naming arms or left inert). Pin un-ignored. GAUNTLET: cargo build --workspace OK; cargo test --workspace 647 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings PASS; cargo fmt --all --check PASS. Hand back for acto-critic re-audit.
